reply: Best fit: `dv_dt ≈ 12.3·exp(-0.67·√v) − 0.133·t² + 2.43·sin(0.567·t)·√v`, with training NMSE 2.9e-24. The exponential's prefactor (12.3) doesn't equal its exponent constant (0.67), so it doesn't match the colleague's `c*exp(-c*sqrt v)` form exactly. The fit is still exact on the training data.
